rationale.conceptual: The method is standard spin-polarized DFT with PAW pseudopotentials and GGA-PW91, but correctly setting up slab models with mirror symmetry, appropriate k-points, and solution energy formulas requires careful implementation of established techniques, not a novel algorithm.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves multiple DFT calculations (bulk references, multiple slab relaxations), data extraction, and post-processing into CSV files; a multi-stage workflow with dependencies and environment setup, but no complex orchestration beyond standard DFT tooling.
